environment: Python 3.10 or later (requires-python >=3.10; CI tests 3.10 and 3.13), managed with uv (uv.lock, no package build). Run the tests with: uv run --frozen pytest (tests/unit and tests/integration). Cut each work item's branch from origin/main. Work items that can be built independently may each be built in parallel in a worktree of their own. Before a change to how the hook builds turns or sends traces is merged, its ticket test runs live: a headless Claude Code session (claude -p --plugin-dir <the branch's worktree>) in a scratch git folder whose own .claude/settings.local.json holds the Langfuse keys, read back through the Langfuse API. The result is posted on the work item, and the test traces are deleted afterwards. Live tests run against two Langfuse Cloud EU test projects, A and B, kept for testing only. On the operator's machine their keys are in ~/.config/mate-record-test/keys.env (LANGFUSE_A_PUBLIC_KEY, LANGFUSE_A_SECRET_KEY, LANGFUSE_B_PUBLIC_KEY, LANGFUSE_B_SECRET_KEY); in GitHub Actions they are secrets of the environment langfuse-test. Never print a key or write it anywhere else.
design: A comment on the work item's GitHub issue.
